Gives the number of saves that are not done yet. With [AsyncSaving](AsyncSaving) off every save is done when the command returns, so this is always 0. A loop that waits for it costs little, and a program that does not wait for it still gets its files (see [AsyncSaving](AsyncSaving)).

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
Cls
Color 0, 200, 0
Oval 20, 20, 200, 160, 1
Flip
AsyncSaving True
SaveBuffer FrontBuffer(), "pending.jxl", "lossless=1,effort=9"
While SavesPending() > 0
	Delay 10
Wend
Print "done, failed: " + SavesFailed()
WaitKey
```
@returns How many saves are still being encoded or written.

This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no asynchronous saving.
